title: Événements
description: System events of this computer over the last 7 days: counts of critical errors, errors, unexpected shutdowns, blue screens / kernel panics, application crashes and hangs, hardware and memory errors (WHEA, machine checks, out-of-memory kills) and failed updates; the reliability index (Windows); then one table per kind (unexpected shutdowns, blue screens with bug check code and probable cause, application crashes with faulting module, hardware errors, failed updates), the most frequent recurring errors grouped by source, and the latest errors. Findings flag blue screens, kernel panics, unexpected shutdowns, repeated application crashes, hardware errors, out-of-memory kills, failed updates and a low reliability index.

functions.name: query
functions.title: Recherche dans les journaux
functions.description: Searches the event logs of this computer with filters: log (Windows log name such as System or Application; on Linux 'system' for the whole journal or 'kernel'), source (Windows provider name; Linux syslog identifier or systemd unit), event ID (Windows), minimum level, time window and text. Returns the matching events, newest first, with time, level, source, ID and message.

parameters.name: log
parameters.label: Journal
parameters.description: Windows: log name (System, Application, Security, Setup or any event log). Linux: 'system' (whole journal) or 'kernel'.

parameters.name: source
parameters.label: Source
parameters.description: Windows: provider name (ex. Microsoft-Windows-Kernel-Power). Linux: syslog identifier (ex. sshd) or systemd unit (ex. NetworkManager.service).

parameters.name: eventId
parameters.label: ID d'événement
parameters.description: Windows event ID (ex. 41, 1000, 7031). Ignored on Linux.

parameters.name: level
parameters.label: Niveau minimal
parameters.description: Minimum level: critical, error, warning or info.

parameters.name: sinceHours
parameters.label: Depuis (heures)
parameters.description: Time window, in hours before now.

parameters.name: contains
parameters.label: Texte
parameters.description: Keep only events whose message contains this text (case-insensitive).

functions.name: get_timeline
functions.title: Chronologie
functions.description: Correlated timeline of this computer over the last days: boots and shutdowns (clean or unexpected), blue screens / kernel panics, application crashes, hardware errors, software and update installs, and critical errors, merged and sorted by time. Use it to see what happened just before a problem (ex. a driver installed before the first blue screen).

functions.name: get_reliability
functions.title: Historique de fiabilité
functions.description: Windows reliability history: the stability index (1 to 10) day by day and the reliability records (application failures, Windows failures, miscellaneous failures, installs) over the last days.

functions.name: export_log
functions.title: Exporter un journal
functions.description: Exports an event log of this computer over a time window to a new file in Documents/SysInfo/Exports (never elsewhere, never overwriting), to archive it or send it to a technician. Windows: wevtutil (.evtx file, opens in Event Viewer; the Security log needs administrator rights). Linux: journalctl, whole journal or kernel, as text (ISO timestamps) or JSON. The preview shows the number of events and the file name; returns the file path and size. The file content is not returned.

parameters.name: log
parameters.label: Journal
parameters.description: Windows: log name (System, Application, Setup, Security…). Linux: 'system' (whole journal) or 'kernel'. Default: System on Windows, system on Linux.

parameters.name: sinceHours
parameters.label: Depuis (heures)
parameters.description: Time window, in hours before now.

parameters.name: level
parameters.label: Niveau minimal
parameters.description: Keep all events, or only critical, error or warning and more severe.

parameters.name: format
parameters.label: Format
parameters.description: Linux: text or json. Windows always writes .evtx.
